update.releaseNotes:
Version 3.5.0.11 Release Notes:
✨ New Features: 🛠️ Complete System Overview & Architecture • Updated the Release Notes New Features to include the automatic backup schedule change (8 AM, 9 AM, 12 PM, 3 PM, 6 PM, 8 PM) and noted updates
File Separation Security: The extractor selectively filters files inside the chosen backup archive, ensuring only .dbf extension files are handled and written to prevent directory clutter or data corruption.
On-Demand Location Overwrite: When Restore is executed, a FolderBrowserDialog allows the Admin to pinpoint exactly where they want to unpack the data, safely displaying a warning dialog before executing a hard overwrite of matching database tables.
Please update to access the new sales centers and benefit from improved robustness and error handling.
